summary: Describes a situation in which the Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), the routing protocol between autonomous systems, can fall into a persistent route oscillation that never settles. It explains the conditions that cause this behavior.

eli5.summary: Imagine two people who keep changing their minds because of what the other chose, so neither ever settles. This document explains how internet routers can get stuck in that loop.

questions: what is bgp persistent route oscillation
why do bgp routes keep flapping
